syllabus.title: Practice Test-06 Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• Current Electricity(Complete Chapter)
• Moving Charges and Magnetism : Introduction, Biot-Savart's Law

📌 CHEMISTRY
• Optical Isomerism (Complete Chapter)
• Haloalkanes and Haloarenes: Introduction, Classification of Haloalkanes & Haloarenes, IUPAC Nomenclature, Nature of C-X bond, Method of preparation of Haloalkanes (Only from Alcohols) & Electrophile and Nucleophile

📌 BOTANY
• Principle of Inheritance and Variation (Complete Chapter)

📌 ZOOLOGY
• Human Health and Diseases : Introduction, Immunity,Innate immunity, Acquired immunity, Lymphoid organs,
• Immunisation,Vaccination, Transplantation, Allergy, Autoimmunity, Diseases- Bacterial diseases, Viral diseases, Helminthiasis diseases
